posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
The community has discovered the official unlock condition for Dark Watch Harpy.

Defeat Advanced GloomWeaver in the Realm of Discord with The Harpy on the team. Flip all control tokens to avian, then all to arcana. After that, they must remain all arcana until the end of the game. The Harpy must destroy at least one villain relic, and may not be incapacitated.

NOTE: There is a bug where you can unlock the variant in any environment. This will be fixed in the next update.

NOTE: There is a bug where you can unlock the variant in any environment. This will be fixed in the next update.
